title: Subgroups of every prime-power order dividing a finite group order
statement: Let $G$ be a group with finite underlying set [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set], let $p$ be a prime natural number, and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. If $p^n$ divides $|G|$, then there is a subgroup $K\subseteq G$ with $|K|=p^n$. Here $|G|$ and $|K|$ count elements; a subgroup is a subset containing $1$ and closed under multiplication and inverse.
